description: Four two-input logic gates sharing one selectable function, with a switch on every input and a stepped voltage output that reads the four results as a four bit number

params.text: With the B switch this picks the logic function: both down is AND, this one down and B up is ADD, this one up and B down is OR, both up is XOR
With the A switch this picks the logic function: both down is AND, A down and this one up is ADD, A up and this one down is OR, both up is XOR
Passes the input of the same number into the logic while it is up; in the down position that input is held low whatever is patched to it

inputs.text: A gate into the logic pair that IN 5 also feeds; their result is the eights bit of the stepped output
A gate into the logic pair that IN 6 also feeds; their result is the fours bit of the stepped output
A gate into the logic pair that IN 7 also feeds; their result is the twos bit of the stepped output
A gate into the logic pair that IN 8 also feeds; their result is the ones bit of the stepped output

outputs.text: The four logic results read as a four bit number and put out as a staircase of sixteen levels from 0V to 10V
The logic function of IN 1 and IN 5 as a 0 to 10V gate, and the eights bit of the stepped output
The logic function of IN 2 and IN 6 as a 0 to 10V gate, and the fours bit of the stepped output
The logic function of IN 3 and IN 7 as a 0 to 10V gate, and the twos bit of the stepped output
The logic function of IN 4 and IN 8 as a 0 to 10V gate, and the ones bit of the stepped output

notes: Every one of the eight input switches comes up in the down position, so a newly placed BTMX holds all eight inputs low and puts out nothing until at least one switch is raised.
An input whose switch is up and which has no cable is held at 10V. In OR that pins its output high; in AND it stops that pair blocking; in XOR it inverts the other input of the pair.
An input counts as high above 1V and falls low below 0V, not at the 2.8V threshold the hardware manual gives.
Every jack is read on one channel only, so a polyphonic cable is used at its first channel.
